tools.name: primes_head
tools.description: The next integer to be minted (the head). Backed by the ledger's getHead.

tools.name: primes_floor
tools.description: The internal floor price p_f = T / S, as its raw numerator and denominator. It is strictly increasing on every mint (CONCEPT.md §5).

tools.name: primes_route
tools.description: How a given number can be acquired right now, read live off the chain: at the head for 1 TON, as a lot ahead of the head, or already minted.

n.description: The integer, as a decimal string.

tools.name: primes_lot
tools.description: One number's live lot state from the market's getLot: mode, standing price and the minimum next bid.

tools.name: primes_open_lots
tools.description: Lots currently open, newest first. Candidates from the index — each is settled on chain before anything is signed.

tools.name: primes_open_builds
tools.description: Constellation builds still waiting for a generator, optionally narrowed to one operation (1..18). The discovery bounties are a first-come window over this graph.

tools.name: primes_portfolio
tools.description: The numbers one wallet holds, from the index's replay of observed transfers. These are CANDIDATES: run primes_confirm_numbers over them before offering a claim, because a number sold since is still listed here.

tools.name: primes_number
tools.description: Who owns one number and what tribute stands to it, read off that number's own NFT item (getNumberData + getOwed).

tools.name: primes_build_state
tools.description: One constellation build's live state from the registrar's getBuild: which inputs are proved, whether the registrar holds the generator yet, and the HEAD it expires at.

tools.name: primes_discovery_owed
tools.description: Unclaimed discovery bounties for one wallet, in nanoPRIMES, from the bounty vault (D-107).

tools.name: primes_discovery_tier
tools.description: One discovery tier's first-come window: how many slots were funded and how many are gone. 15 legendary, 65 rare. `configured: false` is a tier the genesis schedule never funded.

tools.name: primes_generators
tools.description: Every invite generator ever deployed to one wallet. Indexed history: the owner column is MINT-TIME, and a generator is transferable, so the item's own getGeneratorData is who holds it now.

tools.name: primes_name
tools.description: Who holds the naming right over one number (CONCEPT.md §4.7.1) and what name stands on it. The right belongs to a prime's FINDER, not to whoever holds it now.

tools.name: primes_contracts
tools.description: The deployment manifest: which address holds which CONCEPT.md §3.4 role. An unset role is omitted rather than sent as null.

tools.name: primes_wallet
tools.description: Everything one wallet holds and has earned: its TON balance, its PRIMES balance, both CONCEPT.md §4.7 rank ladders, and any unclaimed discovery bounty. Defaults to this server's own wallet when no address is given.

address.description: Defaults to the configured signing wallet.

tools.name: primes_ratchet
tools.description: Whether flush() is worth calling right now: the TON pending, the TON already swapped, the floor it must fill at or below, the venue pool's CURRENT price, and when the last attempt ran and what it did. `outcome: bounced` is a venue refusing, which looks identical to an idle one without this field.

tools.name: primes_lot_price
tools.description: What opening a lot on one number would cost, and WHICH LANE it lands in: 0 ascending (composite), 2 prime Dutch, -1 not openable at all. Read this before primes_open_lot.

tools.name: primes_confirm_numbers
tools.description: Confirm ownership of up to 24 numbers against each one's OWN NFT item. The portfolio list is replayed from indexed transfers and goes stale the moment a number is sold; this is the read that settles it, and the one to run before offering any claim.

tools.name: primes_constellation
tools.description: One BUILT constellation from the second number line: the operation that made it, its inputs, its contributors and the classes it landed in.

tools.name: primes_invite_config
tools.description: Whether CONCEPT.md §4.1's invite line is armed on this deployment, and the public key an invite list's signature is verified against. Without it, mint({ invites }) has nothing to carry.

tools.name: primes_audit
tools.description: The three auditor surfaces in one call: supply (S, and what has been burned out of it), solvency (each contract's balance against its DECLARED liability, §3.4) and the PRIMES sink. Every figure carries the get-method behind it.

tools.name: primes_mint
tools.description: Mint the number at the head for a flat 1 TON. The factorization proof is computed for you; the head is re-read from the chain first and the call refuses if it has moved.

beneficiary.description: Gift the number to this address (CONCEPT.md §4.5).

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.

tools.name: primes_bid
tools.description: Bid on a lot. On an ascending lot this is a raise; on a prime's descending lot the bid IS the purchase and it settles in the same transaction.

bidNanoton.description: Defaults to the live minimum next bid.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.

tools.name: primes_open_lot
tools.description: Open an ascending lot on any number ahead of the head, prime or composite (D-88). Opening IS the first bid, at P0(n) or above; a composite carries its factorization, a prime is checked by the contract.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.

tools.name: primes_open_head_lot
tools.description: Open a prime's descending lot. Gas only: the buyer supplies the payload, not the opener.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.

tools.name: primes_build
tools.description: Open a constellation build: a target, one of the 18 operations, and its inputs. Free of TON beyond gas, and it moves neither the head nor the supply.

inputs.description: Ascending and duplicate-free — the registrar refuses any other order.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.

tools.name: primes_flush
tools.description: Call flush() on the ratchet. Permissionless and gas-only: TON has no scheduler, so pending TON becomes a bid at or below the floor only when somebody sends this. Refused when nothing is pending, and inside the 24h cooldown.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.

tools.name: primes_close_lot
tools.description: Close an ascending lot whose clock has run. Permissionless and gas-only — the winner is already decided, this is the message that settles it.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.

tools.name: primes_prove_input
tools.description: Prove one input's ownership on an open build. One message per input; the index is into the registrant's own input list.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.

tools.name: primes_send_generator
tools.description: Send one invite generator into an open build — the only way a build can ever close. IRREVERSIBLE: closing burns the generator, and so does expiry. The generator's id and kind are read off the item itself.

generatorAddress.description: The GENERATOR ITEM's own contract address, not a wallet.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.

tools.name: primes_close_build
tools.description: Close a build: classify the target, mint the constellation to whoever closes it, and burn the held generator. The closer pays for the 13-base Miller-Rabin.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.

tools.name: primes_expire_build
tools.description: Expire an abandoned build and reopen its target. Permissionless, PAYS NOTHING, and legal only once the HEAD has passed the build's expiry head — the clock is a head, never a wall clock.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.

tools.name: primes_claim_tribute
tools.description: Claim the tribute owed to one number you own — §4.1's divisor share. The message goes to that number's own item, and only its owner may send it.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.

tools.name: primes_claim_discovery
tools.description: Claim this wallet's accrued constellation discovery bounties from the bounty vault. Permissionless and keyed on the sender.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.

tools.name: primes_annotate
tools.description: Write the free first engraving on an era trophy — one of §7's eight primorials (CONCEPT.md §4.7.1, D-179). Once only, by the trophy's holder. A prime's naming, and every re-engraving, burns PRIMES worth 1 TON at the floor through the sink, which this tool does not send.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.
